summary.prose: Building s1 reshapes the shipped model catalog into the three-family definitions file and makes its loader synchronous and strict, adds a per-thread registry that also reads the user's approved models, has every worker load that registry when it starts, and moves the daemon's file check ahead of the settings reconcile. Nothing that resolves models changes yet; providers.listModels keeps answering through the old accessor until s2.

tasks.title: Reshape the definitions file and make validateModelCatalog the synchronous, fully-checked loader
tasks.summary: Rewrite src/assets/models/cloud-model-catalog.json to the families shape with today's models, aliases, efforts, limits and defaults; extend the types and validateShape in src/daemon/model-catalog.ts with every LLD rule (including the tier-default effort rule); turn validateModelCatalog into the synchronous, per-thread cached loader that returns the file; keep the error type, asset location and test seams and add the INSRC_MODEL_CATALOG_DIR test seam; re-implement getCuratedCatalog().modelsFor as a projection of the CLI families so providers.listModels keeps its answer. Rewrite the catalog and asset tests for the new shape.
acceptanceChecks: validateModelCatalog throws ModelCatalogValidationError synchronously, naming entry and rule, for each refusal fixture
The shipped asset validates and carries today's models, aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku) and qwen3.6:27b with 32768 tokens

The shipped asset's cli-claude tier defaults equal DEFAULT_TIERS (opus/sonnet/haiku), its cli-codex defaults equal the installer's block (gpt-6-astra/gpt-6.1-sol/gpt-6-luna), and its summariser models equal SUMMARISER_CLI_FALLBACK (haiku/gpt-6-luna)
providers.listModels returns the Claude and Codex model lists through getCuratedCatalog
The existing list-models suite passes unchanged

tests.name: model-catalog.test.ts: one synchronous refusal per fixture reason, each naming the entry and rule (incl. the three tier-default effort fixtures)
model-catalog.test.ts: validateModelCatalog returns and caches the frozen file; a second call does not re-read
model-catalog.test.ts: getCuratedCatalog().modelsFor projects each CLI family's listed models in file order

model-catalog-asset.test.ts: shipped asset validates, ships via copy-assets, lists today's models and aliases, and its tier defaults and summariser models equal DEFAULT_TIERS, the installer Codex block and SUMMARISER_CLI_FALLBACK

tasks.title: Add the approved-model store path and the per-thread ModelRegistry
tasks.summary: Add PATHS.approvedModels and src/daemon/model-registry.ts: getModelRegistry() builds and caches per thread from validateModelCatalog() plus the store (missing = empty; malformed store or entry logged and ignored; effective profile = latest decidedAt; shadowed approvals ignored), and implements every sc2 method including effortLevels over shipped and effective approved models and resolveTier with decision-A fallback and dropped efforts.
acceptanceChecks: Every ModelRegistry method returns what the LLD postconditions state for the fixtures
effortLevels includes an approved-only effort and excludes rejected or shadowed ones
resolveTier distinguishes rejected-model from unlisted-model, falls back per family (default family for Ollama) and never returns an effort its model does not accept
The ac2 fixture's added model, alias and 'turbo' effort are served after a reset with no code change
A malformed store or bad entry is logged and ignored without throwing

tests.name: model-registry.test.ts: store fixtures (absent, malformed, wrong shape, one bad entry, shadowed approval, approved-vs-rejected by decidedAt) yield the stated models() and rejected()
model-registry.test.ts: effortLevels includes an approved-only effort after its family's shipped efforts and excludes rejected or shadowed efforts

model-registry.test.ts: resolveTier keeps an accepted effort, drops an unaccepted one, falls back with rejected-model vs unlisted-model, uses the default family for an Ollama tier, and an alias-named default's effort is returned and accepted
model-registry.test.ts: ac2 fixture after reset serves the new model, alias and 'turbo' through models(), find(), effortLevels(), resolveTier() and getCuratedCatalog()
model-registry.test.ts: getModelRegistry() returns the same cached registry after the file changes on disk

tasks.title: Load and validate the registry when every worker starts
tasks.summary: Call getModelRegistry() in startDaemonWorker (src/daemon/threads/worker-entry.ts) before it returns, so a bad file fails the worker's start; prove it with real worker threads using the INSRC_MODEL_CATALOG_DIR seam.
acceptanceChecks: A worker started against a corrupted asset fails its start with ModelCatalogValidationError
A worker started after the asset or store changed on disk builds its registry from the new contents while the main thread keeps its own
The thread suites (worker-stores, supervisor, threads-boot) pass with the real shipped asset loaded at worker start, and no test helper needs an asset override

tests.name: worker-model-registry.test.ts: a worker started with INSRC_MODEL_CATALOG_DIR pointing at a corrupted copy fails its start with ModelCatalogValidationError
worker-model-registry.test.ts: a worker started after the asset copy and store changed reports the new models while the main thread's registry keeps the old ones
worker-stores, supervisor and threads-boot suites pass unchanged with the shipped asset

tasks.title: Move the boot validation ahead of the settings reconcile
tasks.summary: Move the validateModelCatalog call in src/daemon/index.ts from step 6d'' to just before the reconcile (step 2b), keeping it fatal; prove with a daemon boot in a temp home against a corrupted asset.
acceptanceChecks: Booting with a corrupted asset exits with ModelCatalogValidationError naming the entry
No config.json is created in a fresh temp home and the socket never opens
A valid asset boots as before

tests.name: boot-model-catalog.test.ts: daemon entry in a temp home with INSRC_MODEL_CATALOG_DIR pointing at a corrupted copy exits non-zero with the error naming the entry, writes no config.json and never creates the socket
boot-model-catalog.test.ts: with the shipped asset the daemon boots and listens

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: validateModelCatalog / validateShape in src/daemon/model-catalog.ts (src/daemon/__tests__/model-catalog.test.ts, rewritten for the families shape; refusals asserted with assert.throws on the synchronous call instead of assert.rejects)
getModelRegistry and every ModelRegistry method in src/daemon/model-registry.ts (new src/daemon/__tests__/model-registry.test.ts)

effortLevels() over shipped and effective approved models: an approved effort absent from every shipped model is included after its family's shipped efforts; a rejected or shadowed profile's efforts are not

resolveTier fallback: with a fixture whose tier default names a model by alias and carries an effort that model accepts, a tier set to an unlisted model falls back to that default with that effort, and the returned effort is in the returned model's efforts

A worker started through startDaemonWorker (src/daemon/threads/worker-entry.ts) after the asset was corrupted fails its start with the validation error
A worker started after the asset or the store changed on disk builds its registry from the new contents while the main thread's cached registry keeps the old ones

The shipped src/assets/models/cloud-model-catalog.json validates, ships via copy-assets (src/daemon/__tests__/model-catalog-asset.test.ts), lists every model and alias today's defaults use (opus, sonnet, haiku, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna, qwen3.6:27b) and has tier defaults equal to today's DEFAULT_TIERS and installer Codex block
